learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a rational questioning approach within the framework of a practice related to human work.
Acquire a data collection methodology adapted to this questioning.
Appropriate knowledge related to a practice connected to human work.
Connect "practices" and "theories" based on the professional experience of apprentice engineers (in conjunction with practice analysis sessions).
Transform this knowledge into professional know-how.

syllabus_topics: Defenses of mini-thesis in Applied Social Sciences to Work
teaching_methods: Interventions related to various fields of human work
Three-year research project based on a professional situation from the apprentice's host company (culminating in a thesis)
Individualized follow-up with a module instructor (for questioning, research structuring, and correction of deliverables and thesis)
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
